correctness.rationale: The one- and two-factor construction uses parent-before-descendant lexicographic folds, each contractive on its prefix by a coordinate-distance comparison. For d>=3, the explicit fiberwise ancestor projections give <=1 distortion on first-factor edges and <=2 on remaining edges and are coherent compositions of one-point folds; the penultimate retraction must move its omitted vertex away from the unique common intersection of three unit balls, forcing >=2. All finite root/tree degrees are covered analytically. Standalone checker independently enumerates pairs and all prefix maps for representative star/path products; finite checks are not substituted for infinite-parameter proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete sharp classification over every finite product of arbitrary unweighted trees, not a one-graph or numerical increment. It identifies the exact loss of nonexpansive coherent one-point retractions upon passage from two to three nontrivial factors, and gives explicit rank-independent 2-Lipschitz constructions. It supplies sharply controlled bases for the corresponding real Lipschitz-free spaces, naturally refining the 2019–2021 retractional-basis constructions.
